rows.ID_C_ISB_MELEEHEAL_DESC: When using MELEE STRIKES to defeat an enemy, the ISB AGENT replenishes a portion of her base health.

rows.ID_HINTCHARACTERS_SPECIALS_NT_01: The Caphex Spy's SCANNER BEACON ability can be retriggered to call in an orbital strike if placed outdoors.
rows.ID_HINTCHARACTERS_SPECIALS_NT_02: The First Order Jet Trooper can hover by holding ZOOM while in air.
rows.ID_HINTCHARACTERS_SPECIALS_NT_03: The First Order Jet Trooper can take off by either pressing the left ability button, or by holding JUMP.
rows.ID_HINTCHARACTERS_SPECIALS_OT_01: The ISB Agent has a series of very fast and nimble melee attacks that allow her to quickly close in on her enemies.
rows.ID_HINTCHARACTERS_SPECIALS_OT_02: While sprinting at full speed with ASSAULT TRANING active, the ISB Agent takes reduced damage.
rows.ID_HINTCHARACTERS_SPECIALS_OT_03: The ISB AGENT regains a portion of health with each melee kill.
rows.ID_HINTCHARACTERS_SPECIALS_PREQ_007: The EWOK HUNTER will automatically find targets to shoot at with its bow.
rows.ID_HINTCHARACTERS_SPECIALS_PREQ_008: The EWOK HUNTER can aim manually and build more power with the bow while zooming.
rows.ID_HINTCHARACTERS_SPECIALS_PREQ_009: When staying crouched, the EWOK HUNTER gains faster recharge speed on all abilities.
rows.ID_HINTCHARACTERS_SPECIALS_PREQ_010: Listen for the EWOK HUNTER voice line indicating full bow power when in zoomed mode.
rows.ID_HINT_CAMPAIGN_CAMERA: Press %%TOGGLECAMERA%% to change between first- and third-person cameras
rows.ID_HINT_CAMPAIGN_CHANGE_ABILITIES: Change your abilities at Supply Crates.
rows.ID_HINT_CAMPAIGN_CHANGE_WEAPON: Change your weapons at Supply Crates.
rows.ID_HINT_CAMPAIGN_DROID_CLUE: Watch the Droid for clues about the enemy's presence.
rows.ID_HINT_CAMPAIGN_SHOULDER: While in third-person, you can tap %%TOGGLECAMERA%% to swap the camera between shoulders
rows.ID_HINT_CAMPAIGN_STORY_ABILITIES: Advance the story to access new abilities to use in the campaign.
rows.ID_HINT_CAMPAIGN_VENT_BLASTER: Vent your blaster before it overheats and becomes disabled.
rows.ID_HINT_CAMPAIGN_VIEW: Press %%VIEWABILITIES%% to view your equipped abilities and their utility
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_HEROES_BOBA_001: Boba Fett’s position is hidden from enemy radar while For The Hunt is active.
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_HEROES_BOBA_002: Boba Fett’s Concussion Rocket causes enemies to become dazed and unable to see clearly
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_HEROES_BOBA_003: Boba Fett’s Jetpack enables him to quickly traverse the map and ambush his enemies from above
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_HEROES_BOSSK_001: Firing too early when using the scope of Bossk’s Relby V-10 will result in dealing less damage with the shot.
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_HEROES_BOSSK_002: If Bossk equips the Name Your Poison Star Card, he will regenerate health while standing within the effects of his Dioxis Grenade.
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_HEROES_BOSSK_003: Bossk is strong at holding an area or objective location, using his Mines and Dioxis Grenade to keep enemies at bay
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_HEROES_CHEWBACCA_001: If you need to focus on a single target, Chewbacca’s Bowcaster can fire a tighter spread of shots by using the alternate fire.
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_HEROES_CHEWBACCA_002: Chewbacca’s Slam can be activated at any time he is charging by repressing the ability button
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_HEROES_CHEWBACCA_003: Chewbacca’s high survivability and powerful abilities make him great in close quarters engagements
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_HEROES_EMPEROR_001: Using both of the Emperor’s hands together will deliver a much more damaging lightning attack--but at the cost of a greater drain on the player’s Stamina.
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_HEROES_EMPEROR_002: The Emperor’s Dark Aura slows and damages targets within its area of effect.
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_HEROES_EMPEROR_003: The Emperor is at his most powerful when he is engaging with multiple enemies at close range
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_HEROES_GENERAL_DEFLEC: Heroes can only block attacks from the front. Try to position around them and hit them from behind to be effective.
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_HEROES_GENERAL_DODGE: All heroes can dodge or evade. Use this to avoid damage and open distance between you and your enemy.
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_HEROES_GENERAL_DODGEM: Dodge is most effective at avoiding lightsaber attacks and opening space between you and the attacker.
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_HEROES_GENERAL_REGEN: Heroes will only regenerate a limited amount of health after taking damage.
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_HEROES_GENERAL_STAMIN: Each time a blocking hero deflects damage or swings their lightsaber, they lose stamina. When out of stamina, heroes are unable to deflect or trigger a closing strike.
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_HEROES_GENERAL_STARCA: Use Star Cards to ensure your hero experience is personally tailored.
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_HEROES_GENERAL_STRENG: Heroes have strengths and weaknesses. Hone your skills by playing Arcade.
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_HEROES_HANSOLO_001: Use Han Solo’s Shoulder Charge to finish off enemies at range
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_HEROES_HANSOLO_002: Han Solo can detonate his Detonite Charge at any time after throwing it by repressing the ability button
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_HEROES_HANSOLO_003: Han Solo is best played aggressively, using his high damage abilities to blast his enemies
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_HEROES_IDEN_001: Iden’s Stun Droid can be avoided with a well timed evade
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_HEROES_IDEN_002: Iden cannot use her Droid Shield while the droid is at distance to her
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_HEROES_IDEN_003: Iden is a versatile hero, able to deal with enemies up close and at distance with her array of weapons and her Droid
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_HEROES_KYLO_001: Kylo Ren’s Frenzy automatically targets enemies around him with a flurry of devastating lightsaber strikes.
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_HEROES_KYLO_002: Players affected by Kylo Ren’s Freeze will be unable to perform any action for the duration of its effect.
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_HEROES_KYLO_003: Kylo Ren is a powerful manipulator of his enemies for both himself and to aid his allies
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_HEROES_LANDO_001: Lando can use his X-8 Night Sniper's thermal scope to see and engage his enemies through smoke.
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_HEROES_LANDO_002: Lando’s Disabler will scramble the radar of enemies nearby and mark their position for Lando and his allies.
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_HEROES_LANDO_003: Lando is best played cautiously, distracting and ambushing his enemies before ducking into the shadows
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_HEROES_LEIA_001: Use the Alternate Fire on Leia’s Defender pistol to deliver a burst of high damage
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_HEROES_LEIA_002: Leia’s E-11 is particularly effective at damaging lightsaber wielders at close range.
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_HEROES_LEIA_003: Leia is a versatile hero capable of defending her companions or leading the charge.
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_HEROES_LUKE_001: Luke can deflect blaster bolts back at his enemies.
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_HEROES_LUKE_002: Luke can use Push to keep enemies at distance or knock them off ledges.
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_HEROES_LUKE_003: Keeping mobile and ready to close quickly on enemies is the best way for Luke Skywalker to be effective.
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_HEROES_MAUL_001: Darth Maul’s Furious Throw deals damage to enemies on its return.
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_HEROES_MAUL_002: Darth Maul’s Choke Hold can be used to throw enemies from ledges.
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_HEROES_MAUL_003: Maul is most effective when on the move, hitting his enemies and keeping mobile
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_HEROES_REY_001: Rey's movement will be hidden from enemy radar while Insight is active
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_HEROES_REY_002: Rey’s Mind Control causes those affected to have their controls inverted
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_HEROES_REY_003: Rey’s ability to sense her enemies gives her the upper hand in combat and the opportunity to ambush
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_HEROES_VADER_001: Darth Vader’s Focused Rage increases the damage you deal as well as removing the Stamina cost of his lightsaber strikes.
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_HEROES_VADER_002: You can drag and drop enemies off ledges using Darth Vader’s Choke ability.
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_HEROES_VADER_003: Darth Vader’s high survivability allows him to hold his ground against many attackers
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_HEROES_YODA_001: Yoda can absorb blaster fire to charge Unleash, making it more effective.
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_HEROES_YODA_002: Yoda’s Presence ability increases the health of nearby allies as well as himself.
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_HEROES_YODA_003: When playing as Yoda, try to use his small size to your advantage to ambush enemies
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_SPECIALS_ENFORCER_001: Enforcers are sturdy and deal a lot damage.
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_SPECIALS_ENFORCER_002: Each Enforcer has their own special explosive attack.
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_SPECIALS_ENFORCER_003: Enforcers have the ability to FORTIFY themselves for a short time.
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_SPECIALS_ENFORCER_004: An Enforcer's FORTIFY can double as a shield or a heal.
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_SPECIALS_GENERAL_JUMP: Aerial units are each equipped with nimble JETPACKS.
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_SPECIALS_GENERAL_REIN: Special Units deal more damage than regular troopers.
Special Units can take more damage than regular troopers.
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_SPECIALS_JUMPTROOPER_: Use an Aerial's JETPACK DASH to quickly move in a horizontal direction.
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_SPECIALS_PREQ_001: When an enemy inside your Commando Droid Smoke Screen gets defeated, you earn bonus score.
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_SPECIALS_PREQ_002: The Commando Droid uses a swift and deadly vibrosword instead of the normal trooper melee attacks.
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_SPECIALS_PREQ_003: You can use either the right ability trigger or the melee input to trigger the Commando Droid vibrosword attack.
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_SPECIALS_PREQ_004: The ARC Trooper dual wields two Blaster Pistols for maximum firepower, while maintaining full mobility.
rows.ID_HINT_CHARACTERS_SPECIALS_PREQ_006: The DROIDEKA is protected while in WHEEL FORM and while its shield is deployed, but vulnerable while deploying into BATTLE FORM.
rows.ID_HINT_COOP_GENERIC_1: When attacking, capturing one Control Point is enough to advance to the next phase.
rows.ID_HINT_COOP_GENERIC_2: When defending, losing one Control Point is enough to be pushed back.
rows.ID_HINT_COOP_GENERIC_3: Aim at a Control Point and press Interact to let your team know where you will go next.
rows.ID_HINT_COOP_GENERIC_4: The number shown in a blue circle next to a Control Point shows how many friendlies you have there.
rows.ID_HINT_COOP_GENERIC_5: The number shown in yellow next to a Control Point is the number of players in your squad who have marked that point.
rows.ID_HINT_COOP_GENERIC_6: In co-op, you play with friends against AI opponents and level up your characters normally.
rows.ID_HINT_DROIDEKA2: Holding sprint while in WHEEL FORM allows the Droideka to roll at maximum speed.
rows.ID_HINT_GENERAL_03: You can spawn on squad mates unless they are in combat, out of bounds, in a vehicle, or an airborne unit.
rows.ID_HINT_GENERAL_04: You get a small Battle Point amount every time you are defeated.
rows.ID_HINT_GENERAL_05: You will see a small shield icon next to your health when you are buffed with Damage Reduction.
rows.ID_HINT_GENERAL_06: You will see two arrow icons next to your health when you are suffering from Damage Increase from e.g. Dooku's EXPOSE WEAKNESS or BB-8's RESISTANCE BACKING.
rows.ID_HINT_GENERAL_07: You will see an animated shield icon when you hit an enemy that has Damage Reduction, e.g. the Clone Commando's BATTLE FOCUS or Anakin's RETRIBUTION.
rows.ID_HINT_GENERAL_08: There are a plethora of visual options that you can configure under OPTIONS/GAMEPLAY to tweak the UI to your liking.
rows.ID_HINT_GENERAL_09: Reinforcements and Heroes earn Battle Points at a lower rate, since they are more powerful to begin with.
rows.ID_HINT_GENERAL_10: Troopers have Boost Star Cards that give passive bonuses, and Ability Star Cards that can change their gadgets and weapons.
rows.ID_HINT_GENERAL_11: Many characters and classes have additional passive abilities, displayed in the lower left section of your ability overview screen.
rows.ID_HINT_GENERAL_12: If your ability to regain health is blocked (e.g. from the Sith Trooper's OPPRESSION GRENADE) your health bar will be greyed out with a diagonal pattern.
rows.ID_HINT_GENERAL_13: Your health bar will glow briefly when you regain a portion of your health.
rows.ID_HINT_GENERAL_MILESTONE_CLAIM_REWARD: Your earned rewards can be inspected under the Career page.
rows.ID_HINT_GENERAL_MILESTONE_TRY_NEW: Complete milestones to unlock new content for Troopers and Heroes.
rows.ID_HINT_GRIEVOUS_01: General Grievous' THRUST SURGE is a great way to close in on your opponent before destroying them with UNRELENTING ADVANCE.
rows.ID_HINT_GRIEVOUS_02: General Grievous' CLAW RUSH provides for a quick escape while also reducing damage when used offensively.
rows.ID_HINT_GRIEVOUS_03: General Grievous' UNRELENTING ADVANCE will hinder his movement but it makes him an impassable threat in close quarters.
rows.ID_HINT_HVV_NEW_001: When deflecting with a lightsaber Hero, you are still vulnerable from attacks and abilities from behind.
rows.ID_HINT_HVV_NEW_002: All Heroes except Bossk regain a portion of health when they defeat an enemy.
rows.ID_HINT_MODE1_001: Board your troop transport to gain bonus reinforcements for your capital ship assault.
rows.ID_HINT_MODE1_002: A successful defense of your Capital Ship will earn you a Command Post bonus in the next phase.
rows.ID_HINT_MODE1_003: Defeat troops attempting to board transports to prevent the enemy from gaining bonus reinforcements during the capital ship assault.
rows.ID_HINT_MODE1_004: If your hero or reinforcement is alive during a transition phase, you will have your Battle Points refunded.
rows.ID_HINT_MULTIPLAYER_STARFIGHTER_ASSAULT_: You'll deplete the enemy's reinforcement meter faster by defeating other players than by defeating AI enemies.
Attackers must complete all three phases to win. Defenders only need to stop them once!
Destroying turrets can make it easier to defeat your primary objective
Some objectives are only vulnerable for a short period of time. Be ready to do as much damage as you can during this time!
rows.ID_HINT_PLANETARYBATTLE_GENERAL_001: If the enemy has dug in, find alternative routes to flank them.
rows.ID_HINT_PLANETARYBATTLE_GENERAL_002: With more teammates inside the secure area you secure areas quicker.
rows.ID_HINT_PLANETARYBATTLE_GENERAL_003: Stop enemies from securing areas by moving into the secure area.
rows.ID_HINT_PLANETARYBATTLE_GENERAL_004: Securing an area is divided into three phases, each with a checkpoint. Whenever a checkpoint has been reached, the secured progress cannot be reversed beyond that point.
rows.ID_HINT_PLANETARYBATTLE_GENERAL_005: A secured area objective cannot be regained once it has been lost.
rows.ID_HINT_PLANETARYBATTLE_GENERAL_006: If a secure action is interrupted, any progress made in the section will be reset to the latest checkpoint.
rows.ID_HINT_PLANETARYBATTLE_GENERAL_007: Use scouting equipment to locate enemies hiding on the battlefront.
rows.ID_HINT_PLANETARYBATTLE_GENERAL_008: Even one defender inside the securing area stops progression.
rows.ID_HINT_PLANETARYBATTLE_GENERAL_009: Defend teammates when they interact. They are an easy target.
rows.ID_HINT_PLANETARYBATTLE_GENERAL_010: Attackers gain more available reinforcements each time they complete a stage.
rows.ID_HINT_PLANETARYBATTLE_GENERAL_011: The attacking team's reinforcements are added to any remaining from when they completed the phase.
rows.ID_HINT_PLANETARYBATTLE_GENERAL_015: If the attackers manage to get full reinforcement after completing a stage they are rewarded for a great attack.
rows.ID_HINT_PLANETARYBATTLE_GENERAL_016: If the defenders stop the attackers from getting full reinforcement after completing a stage they are rewarded for a great defense.
rows.ID_HINT_PREQ_CLONECOMMANDO: Unlike most blaster wielders, the CLONE COMMANDO has an energy pack that must be manually replaced after a fixed number of shots fired.
rows.ID_HINT_SKIRMISH_BLAST_AI_EXPERT: Set yourself a challenge by setting the AI Skill to Expert.
rows.ID_HINT_SKIRMISH_BLAST_AI_SQUAD: Work together with your AI squad. Teammates will draw fire and nearby officers will give buffs.
rows.ID_HINT_SKIRMISH_BLAST_LIFE: Every life counts. Keep yourself and your teammates alive to prevent the enemy from scoring.
rows.ID_HINT_SKIRMISH_BLAST_READY_TEST: Get ready for Multiplayer by testing out different combinations of Star Cards to find your perfect hand.
rows.ID_HINT_SKIRMISH_BLAST_SWIFT: Can you do it faster? Going for a swift victory will prepare you for the fast pace of Multiplayer combat.
rows.ID_HINT_SKIRMISH_DUEL_FANTASY_SHOWDOWN: Recreate your fantasy showdown and settle the score between light side and dark side once and for all.
rows.ID_HINT_SKIRMISH_DUEL_HERO_STRENGTHS: Get to know each hero's strengths and weaknesses to gain the upper hand.
rows.ID_HINT_SKIRMISH_DUEL_HUNT: Hunt your opponent down. Don't let them escape to hide and regenerate health.
rows.ID_HINT_SKIRMISH_ONSLAUGHT_SPEED: Onslaught is all about speed. You can use as many lives as you need, just don't let the time run out.
rows.ID_HINT_SKIRMISH_ONSLAUGHT_STRATEGY_WIPE: Try out new strategies and ability combinations to find the fastest way to wipe out the opposition.
rows.ID_HINT_SKIRMISH_ONSLAUGHT_TRAINING_HERO: Use Onslaught as a training ground to get fast, effective kills as a hero.
rows.ID_HINT_STARFIGHTERS_GENERAL_AUTO_LEVEL: Auto-leveling of your starfighter's orientation can be disabled in the options screen.
rows.ID_HINT_STARFIGHTERS_GENERAL_CONTROL_CUS: Starfighter controls can be customized in the options screen.
rows.ID_HINT_STARFIGHTERS_GENERAL_MISSILE_DUM: Missiles can be fired unguided by double-tapping the ability button. They will fly in a straight line.
rows.ID_HINT_STARFIGHTERS_GENERAL_OVERHEAT_1: Starfighter abilities are still usable while the primary weapons are overheated.
rows.ID_HINT_STARFIGHTERS_GENERAL_OVERHEAT_2: Starfighter primary weapons will overheat and be unusable for a short period if fired continuously.
rows.ID_HINT_STARFIGHTERS_GENERAL_OVERHEAT_3: Stop firing for a short period before your primary weapon overheats; this might let you get the final blow on an enemy faster.
rows.ID_HINT_STARFIGHTERS_GENERAL_TURN_SLOW: Starfighters will make tighter turns at slower speeds.
rows.ID_HINT_STARFIGHTERS_HEROES_FALCON_DURAB: The Millennium Falcon is durable but surprisingly quick for its size.
rows.ID_HINT_STARFIGHTERS_HEROES_GENERAL_BATT: Fight and score in the match to earn Battle Points and use them to pilot a hero ship.
rows.ID_HINT_STARFIGHTERS_HEROES_KYLO: The TIE silencer fires extremely powerful torpedoes.
rows.ID_HINT_STARFIGHTERS_HEROES_RED5_R2D2: Found in Luke Skywalker's T-65B X-wing, R2-D2 can heal more damage than other astromech Droids.
rows.ID_HINT_STARFIGHTERS_HEROES_SCIMITAR_CLO: When Darth Maul uses the Scimitar's cloaking device, he is very hard to spot and lock-on to.
rows.ID_HINT_STARFIGHTERS_HEROES_SLAVE_SEISMI: Boba Fett's Slave I can drop an incredibly powerful seismic charge capable of damaging everything within a large radius.
rows.ID_HINT_STARFIGHTERS_HEROES_T70_REVEAL: Poe's T-70 X-Wing can reveal nearby enemies and enable allies to do more damage.
rows.ID_HINT_STARFIGHTERS_HEROES_VADER_LASER: Darth Vader's TIE Advanced x1 is specialized for heavy laser cannon damage.
rows.ID_HINT_STARFIGHTERS_HEROES_YODA_SLOW: Yoda’s modified ETA-2 Actis-class light interceptor can emit an Ion Pulse that disables and slows enemies within a large radius.
rows.ID_HINT_STARFIGHTERS_ROLES_BOMBER_MANEUV: Bombers are less maneuverable than other starfighters but can take more punishment.
rows.ID_HINT_STARFIGHTERS_ROLES_BOMBER_MISSIL: Bombers' heavy missiles are capable of doing large amounts of damage to slow or static targets.
rows.ID_HINT_STARFIGHTERS_ROLES_INTERCEPTOR_C: Interceptors excel at chasing down and destroying other starfighters.
rows.ID_HINT_STARFIGHTERS_ROLES_INTERCEPTOR_M: Interceptors are fast and maneuverable but can't take much damage
rows.ID_HINT_STARFIGHTERS_ROLES_MULTI_OFFENCE: Fighters are good on both offense and defense.
rows.ID_HINT_STRIKE_GENERAL_001: Strike can have one of two goals: destroy two objectives or retrieve and extract an objective.
rows.ID_HINT_STRIKE_GENERAL_002: If attackers run out of reinforcements but an objective is still active the round goes into overtime.
rows.ID_HINT_STRIKE_GENERAL_003: Overtime will allow attackers a final chance to complete an already active objective even when out of reinforcements.
rows.ID_HINT_STRIKE_GENERAL_004: A dropped objective will remain on the ground until it times out or the attackers pick it up again.
rows.ID_HINT_STRIKE_GENERAL_005: A dropped objective that times out will be reset to its starting point.
rows.ID_HINT_TROOPER_ASSAULT_001: The Assault Trooper's Smart Ion Grenade will detonate automatically when it is close to an enemy vehicle or shield.
rows.ID_HINT_TROOPER_ASSAULT_002: The Vanguard signature ability allows the Assault trooper to sprint faster and wield a powerful close-range weapon which builds no heat.
rows.ID_HINT_TROOPER_ASSAULT_003: The Assault Trooper's Scan Dart will reveal the location of nearby enemies for a short time.
rows.ID_HINT_TROOPER_ASSAULT_004: An Assault Trooper can use Toughen Up to draw upon their fortitude, constantly regenerating health for a period of time.
rows.ID_HINT_TROOPER_GENERAL_001: Manually initiating the cooling of your weapon is always faster than letting it overheat.
rows.ID_HINT_TROOPER_GENERAL_002: When an ability can be retriggered to perform an additional action, an icon in the ability control panel for that ability will blink.
rows.ID_HINT_TROOPER_GENERAL_003: If your weapon overheats, hit the colored spaces in the overheat skill-game to remove the time penalty. Hitting the smallest space gives you unlimited firing capability for a short while.
rows.ID_HINT_TROOPER_GENERAL_004: Combat roll to avoid being staggered by a melee-attack. During the roll you will also be less sensitive to damage.
rows.ID_HINT_TROOPER_GENERAL_005: Standing close to a Heavy Trooper deployed in Sentry will make you less sensitive to explosive damage.
rows.ID_HINT_TROOPER_GENERAL_006: Firing a weapon makes you show up on enemy scanners.
rows.ID_HINT_TROOPER_GENERAL_007: Ion shot is the most effective munition against vehicles.
rows.ID_HINT_TROOPER_GENERAL_009: If a nearby grenade can hurt you, it will show a red warning icon and its position in your HUD.
rows.ID_HINT_TROOPER_GENERAL_010: Each one of the trooper starting abilities can be improved using Star Cards.
rows.ID_HINT_TROOPER_GENERAL_011: Each trooper has a class-defining signature ability. Star Cards offer modifications to these abilities, all with their own pros and cons.
rows.ID_HINT_TROOPER_GENERAL_12: You'll earn XP each time you play a class. If you earn enough XP to gain a Class Level, you will earn a Skill Point to spend on Star Card unlocks and upgrades.
rows.ID_HINT_TROOPER_GENERAL_13: Use your Skill Points to buy and upgrade Star Cards, once you have reached the required Class Level.
rows.ID_HINT_TROOPER_GENERAL_14: At specific Class Levels, you will reveal new Star Cards for that class. Unlock these Star Cards for use by spending one Skill Point.
rows.ID_HINT_TROOPER_GENERAL_15: Your Player Rank is a global number that shows your overall dedication to the game, but it does not directly affect your progression.
rows.ID_HINT_TROOPER_GENERAL_16: Each class has required Class Levels to be able to take Star Cards to Rare and Epic power levels.
rows.ID_HINT_TROOPER_HEAVY_001: The Heavy trooper's Sentry signature ability variants offers choice between mobility and maximum firepower!
rows.ID_HINT_TROOPER_HEAVY_002: The Heavy Trooper's Combat Shield offers excellent protection from the front. However, it only allows for the use of the trooper's primary weapon.
rows.ID_HINT_TROOPER_HEAVY_003: The Heavy Trooper's Impact Grenade will detonate directly on contact with any object.
rows.ID_HINT_TROOPER_HEAVY_004: The Heavy Trooper has more health than any other class but regenerates health at a slower rate.
rows.ID_HINT_TROOPER_OFFICER_001: The Battle Command signature ability allows the Officer to inspire troops nearby, allowing them to redouble their efforts!
rows.ID_HINT_TROOPER_OFFICER_002: The Officer's Flash Grenade will split into sub-munitions that cover a greater area if triggered again mid-air.
rows.ID_HINT_TROOPER_OFFICER_003: The Officer carries a Defuser device which creates an ionized area around the player capable of automatically defusing nearby explosives, grenades, and mines.
rows.ID_HINT_TROOPER_OFFICER_004: The Officer's Blaster Turret has a self-destruct mechanism which can be triggered remotely, causing damage to nearby enemies.
rows.ID_HINT_TROOPER_OFFICER_005: The Officer's Disruption ability uses a modified defusion coil that, when overloaded, can cause enemy weapons to overheat and disables hostile turrets.
rows.ID_HINT_TROOPER_OFFICER_006: The extra health received from an Officer's Battle Command is only temporary and will wear off after a short while.
rows.ID_HINT_TROOPER_OFFICER_007: Officers will automatically repair damaged turrets if they stay close to them.
rows.ID_HINT_TROOPER_OFFICER_008: The more Officers in range of a damaged turret, the faster it will be repaired.
rows.ID_HINT_TROOPER_SPECIALIST_001: Thermal Binoculars allow the Specialist to survey heat signatures on the battlefront, effectively peering through walls and solid cover.
rows.ID_HINT_TROOPER_SPECIALIST_002: The Infiltration signature ability allows the Specialist to see all enemies on their scanner and draw a weapon suited for medium-ranged combat.
rows.ID_HINT_TROOPER_SPECIALIST_004: The Specialist's Shock Grenade slows enemies down.
rows.ID_HINT_VEHICLE_74Z_001: The Speeder Bike can act as a fast reconnaissance vehicle using the Motion Scan ability.
rows.ID_HINT_VEHICLE_AAT_001: The AAT has exposed critical systems at its rear and under its siege cannon.
rows.ID_HINT_VEHICLE_AAT_002: Using the Siege Gun keeps the AAT stationary, leaving the vulnerable back exposed.
rows.ID_HINT_VEHICLE_ATST_001: The AT-ST has exposed critical systems at the rear of the cockpit.
rows.ID_HINT_VEHICLE_GENERAL_002: If you spent Battle Points on a vehicle, leaving it will destroy it.
rows.ID_HINT_VEHICLE_LAAT_001: You can extend your time in the LAAT gunship by defeating enemies with it.
rows.ID_HINT_VEHICLE_LIUV_001: The backs of the LIUV´s turbines are its most vulnerable spots.
rows.ID_HINT_VEHICLE_T47_001: Skilled pilots can use the Airspeeder´s tow cable to take down a weakened AT-AT.
rows.ID_HINT_VEHICLE_UWING_001: You can extend your time in the U-Wing gunship by defeating enemies with it.
rows.ID_HINT_VEHICLE_X34_001: The engines of the X34 Landspeeder are more vulnerable than its chassis.
rows.ID_HUD_CAMPAIGN_HANSOLO_DEATH: HAN SOLO WAS UNLUCKY ON TAKODANA
rows.ID_HUD_CAMPAIGN_LANDO_DEATH: LANDO CALRISSIAN LOST HIS LAST GAMBLE
rows.ID_HUD_CAMPAIGN_LEIA_DEATH: PRINCESS LEIA FAILED TO SAVE NABOO
rows.ID_HUD_CAMPAIGN_LUKE_DEATH: LUKE SKYWALKER WAS DEFEATED ON PILLIO
rows.ID_H_ANAKIN_TIPS_1: Anakin Skywalker's ultimate ability RETRIBUTION charges up when friendly characters near him are defeated or damaged, as well as when he is injured.
rows.ID_H_ANAKIN_TIPS_2: Anakin Skywalker's PULL DOMINANCE can easily be combined with area of effect abilities from friendly characaters.
rows.ID_H_ANAKIN_TIPS_3: Anakin Skywalker's HEROIC MIGHT can be held down to highly reduce damage and increase its final effect.
rows.ID_H_BB8_ABILITY_SWIFTREACTION_DESC: BB-8 passively increases the cooldown speed of friendly characters around him.
rows.ID_H_BB8_ABILITY_TECHNICALSUPPORT_DESC: BB-8 counts as two units when capturing a point and activates objectives faster.
rows.ID_H_BB8_TIPS_1: BB-8 is extremely agile on the battlefront. Use this edge to zip between multiple hot zones and help your allies.
rows.ID_H_BB8_TIPS_2: BB-8 has several passive abilities. Position yourself on the battlefront to make the most of them.
rows.ID_H_BB8_TIPS_3: Enemies affected by BB-8's RESISTANCE BACKING will get misleading data on their radar.
rows.ID_H_BB9E_ABILITY_BACTASUPPORT_DESC: BB-9E passively regenerates the health of close by allies.
rows.ID_H_BB9E_ABILITY_TECHNICALSUPPORT_DESC: BB-9E counts as two units when capturing a point and activates objectives faster.
rows.ID_H_BB9E_TIPS_1: BB-9E is extremely agile on the battlefront. Use this edge to zip between multiple hot zones and help your allies.
rows.ID_H_BB9E_TIPS_2: BB-9E has several passive abilities. Position yourself on the battlefront to make the most of them.
rows.ID_H_BB9E_TIPS_3: Enemies wielding lightsabers inside BB-9E's SMOKE SCREEN will have a hard time closing in on their targets.
rows.ID_H_DOOKU_TIPS_01: Count Dooku is a menacing opponent up close but is not as powerful against enemies far away or in greater numbers.
rows.ID_H_DOOKU_TIPS_02: Count Dooku has a stronger Dodge Ability than most characters. It recharges faster and can be performed more times in consecutive order.
rows.ID_H_DOOKU_TIPS_03: DUELIST boosts Count Dooku's lightsaber attacks, surprising his enemies with faster and more devastating blows.
rows.ID_H_FINN_TIP_1: Finn's BIG DEAL grants him more damage reduction the more allies are affected.
rows.ID_H_FINN_TIP_2: The EL-16 will continue target enemies until the active time is over.
rows.ID_H_FINN_TIP_3: During UNDERCOVER TEAM, the range affecting enemies and friendlies is different.
rows.ID_H_PHASMA_TIP_1: The shock from Captain Phasma's FIRST ORDER SENTRY is automatic when enemies come in range.
rows.ID_H_PHASMA_TIP_2: Captain Phasma's SONN-BLAS F-11D has two different zoom functionalities: a night vision and a high level zoom.
rows.ID_H_PHASMA_TIP_3: Captain Phasma's SURVIVOR ability can give her a temporary health bonus beyond her maximum value.
rows.ID_H_TIPS_OBIWAN_02: Obi-Wan Kenobi's DEFENSIVE RUSH can be retriggered at any time by pressing the Attack button, unleashing a powerful ligthsaber swing .
rows.ID_H_TIPS_OBIWAN_03: Obi-Wan Kenobi's ALL-OUT PUSH can be released at any moment if time is of the essence.
